# Chiefly

> Chiefly is a personal AI chief of staff. A private AI that runs on your computer: local by default, cloud opt-in. Pay once, no subscription. You pay once, and your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t. Updates may stop; your copy keeps working.

It runs on your computer. It asks before it acts.

The waitlist is open. Coming this December. Join the waitlist.

Chiefly asks before it acts. Nothing happens until you say so.

Launch prices won’t go back down. First 100 buyers: Regular $199, Student $69. After that: Regular $299, Student $99. The $69 student price covers four years, or until graduation. Pay once, no subscription. Coming this December. Join the waitlist to hear when it opens.

Student one-time AI: one payment covers four years, or until graduation.

Private, school, and personal work never leaves the computer. When a delegation is approved, only the public task goes. A private turn makes zero outside calls. “What left this computer” shows real sends and refusals, and never invents a number. Files Chiefly saves are locked to the owner. Sensitive approvals use an in-page PIN pad. Chiefly only installs an update it can verify. A held, refused, or failed step is recorded as “Not done,” and names the step.

## Principles

- You own it. You don’t rent it.
- Local by default. Cloud only if you opt in.
- Pay once, no subscription.
- Your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t. Updates may stop; your copy keeps working.
- It works for you, and only you.
- See and delete what it remembers, anytime.
